summary: Backend-only verification of new admin nudge endpoint (POST /api/sessions/nudge/{user_id}) plus static verification of frontend changes. Created /app/backend/tests/test_admin_nudge.py with 5 tests — all pass. Full backend regression via `pytest -n 0`: 170 passed / 4 skipped / 0 failed in 77.97s. Frontend EmployeesManage.jsx contains data-testid=emp-selfie-{id} (line 180) and emp-nudge-{id} (line 189). OfficesManage.jsx contains FALLBACK={lat:9.0820,lng:8.6753} (line 15) and setTimeout(drop, 6500) (line 42) as required.
critical_code_review_comments: nudge endpoint correctly scopes to `user['org_id']` in the Mongo find_one filter, so cross-org isolation is enforced at the query level — verified by test_nudge_cross_org_isolation_returns_404.
Title/body truncation via slice-then-str [:120] and [:280] happens before FCM dispatch, so oversized payloads cannot escape to fcm.googleapis.com.
BackgroundTasks + send_push_to_user is the same pattern already used elsewhere in sessions.py — consistent and non-blocking; the endpoint returns 200 before FCM completes.

Minor observation (not a bug): ObjectId(user_id) will raise bson.errors.InvalidId (→ 500) if a malformed non-hex id is passed. Consider wrapping in try/except → 404 for parity with other endpoints. Non-blocking since only admin UI hits this route and IDs come from /api/employees list.

rca of the issue: N/A — iteration validates fix from main agent. Original problem: admin had no UI entry point to trigger selfie/notify unless employee already had a live session (Send Selfie button was scoped to Live Sessions page), and Office creation's draggable pin was only injected after successful geolocation callback, leaving the map pinless when browser denied location. Fix: (1) new nudge endpoint independent of session state + BackgroundTasks FCM dispatch; (2) per-row Camera + Bell buttons on EmployeesManage; (3) 6.5s setTimeout in OfficeForm drops a fallback pin at Nigeria centroid (9.0820, 8.6753) if geolocation callback never fires.
